by_eye.clean_shift_agreement: 10/10 (5 e-rara, 5 IA; printed page on image = <page-num> of the neighbour text Clef picked)
by_eye.no_neighbour_sample: 5/5 non-text leaves whose stored text is an image description: binding (bsb), heraldic illumination (morgan), coat of arms (bph), front board (IA), fore-edge (IA)
by_eye.no_neighbour_text_pages_extra: 4 opened: 1 real wrong leaf (loc Chinese woodblock), 1 Clef false alarm (bph Dutch blackletter), 1 right page with degenerate OCR (leiden Buginese), 1 unverifiable (bl Tibetan cursive, 3 folios)

summary.method: One random page per visible book (visible:true, pages_count>0), page_number in [1,pages_count], OCR >= 300 chars and an R2 image; pass 1 tries 4 random pages, pass 2 samples among eligible pages server-side. Clef noul same_page question with the page own OCR (first 4000 chars), image 1024px JPEG. Flags (p<0.5) neighbour-checked with clef-shift-check.mjs: clean = image N vs text N+-1 >= 0.95 AND mirror (text N vs image N-+1) >= 0.95; one-sided = any neighbour pair >= 0.7; else no-neighbour-match.
